newsitem.title: INDIA: India bus crash kills 38, injures 20.
newsitem.headline: India bus crash kills 38, injures 20.

text.p: A bus plunged into a 150-foot (45-metre) deep gorge in northern India on Tuesday, killing at least 38 people and injuring 20, police officials said.
The accident occurred at Dharmadi, 82 km (51 miles) northeast of Jammu, the winter capital of Jammu and Kashmir state, they said.

Police told Reuters the bus, at the end of a 45-kilometre (28-mile) journey, was negotiating a sharp curve when it went off the road and plunged into the gorge. All 38 bodies had been recovered, they said.
The injured, including five seriously hurt, had been sent to local hospitals.
Nearly 50,000 people die in road accidents every year in India.
